definitions.explanation: A wish or prayer, especially one made at a shrine, temple, or during a special occasion like Tanabata (Star Festival). Conveys a heartfelt or earnest desire, often directed to a higher power or the universe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a wish at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my wish on a strip of paper for Tanabata.

examples.japanese: ⟦{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}→流れ星：05049_nagareboshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that if you see a shooting star and say your wish three times, it will come true.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{願|ねが}い{事|ごと} is closely associated with shrine and temple visits, especially at ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ (New Year's shrine visit) and during ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧ (Star Festival, July 7), when people write wishes on ⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧ (paper strips) and hang them on bamboo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a wish)
- {願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧ (a wish comes true)
- {願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a wish)
- {願|ねが}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (to say/recite a wish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {願|ねが}い{事|ごと}: wish (heartfelt, often spiritual/festive)
- ⟦{望|のぞ}み→望み：03543_nozomi⟧: hope, wish (broader, more general)
- ⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧: prayer (more religious or solemn)
- ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧: request, favor (directed at a person)
